observedProblem: The existing Dispose() invoked CancellationTokenSource.Cancel() without containing AggregateException. .NET cancellation can synchronously invoke native callback registrations; a throwing third-party registration could interrupt WPF host shutdown and skip _lifetime.Dispose(), _pending.Clear(), and _seenRequestIds.Clear(). This is a source-level defect hypothesis, not an observed native Windows crash.
actualFix: In the existing P01WebView2NavigationBridge.Dispose(), guard _lifetime.Cancel() with try/catch (AggregateException) and put owned lifetime disposal and pending/replay cleanup in finally. Preserve the initial disposed gate and all six WebView2 handler unsubscriptions. Do not add a host or broaden permissions.
